biggest_catch: There is no welcome bonus to earn — the only reward is Daily Cash on purchases, and it requires an iPhone and Apple Pay use to be meaningful.
catches: No welcome bonus is advertised on Apple's official Apple Card page — only Daily Cash on ongoing purchases.
A limited-time AirPods sign-up promo (up to $250 in bonus Daily Cash over 10 months) ran in spring 2026 and has expired; it is no longer offered.
You must have an iPhone/iPad with the latest iOS and add the card to Wallet to use all features — Android users cannot get the card.
Physical titanium card earns only 1% Daily Cash; 2-3% requires Apple Pay.
Carrying a balance at ~17.49%-27.74% variable APR destroys the Daily Cash value; pay in full.
Accepting the card after approval results in a hard inquiry (per Apple's own terms).
